question: Should OpenClaw now retire coalesceSameSenderDms and make imsg 0.11.1 the mandatory iMessage floor, accepting doctor-required upgrades and fatal startup on older binaries?
rationale: This intentionally removes a shipped configuration surface and fallback behavior while adding an operator-visible dependency cutoff, which requires explicit maintainer ownership even though the implementation direction is coherent.

options.title: Accept the planned teardown
options.body: Approve the removal and version floor after rebasing and adding exact-head live macOS split-send and doctor-upgrade proof.

options.title: Preserve compatibility temporarily
options.body: Keep the existing configuration and coalescing path until a later release window provides broader upgrade evidence and communication.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Land only the doctor migration or dependency diagnostics now and defer removing the runtime policy and config surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the planned teardown
recommendation.body: Approve the removal and version floor after rebasing and adding exact-head live macOS split-send and doctor-upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent iMessage transport ownership makes this person the best available maintainer-side owner for accepting the compatibility cutoff.
